manifest.title: 9Router
manifest.tagline: AI router and token saver for coding tools
manifest.description: Routes requests across 40+ AI providers with RTK token saving, multi-account round-robin, MITM proxy, and a unified dashboard. Free providers: Kiro AI (Claude 4.5 unlimited) and OpenCode Free (no auth).
manifest.author: decolua
manifest.packagerName: ericm115 (updated fork; original package by Robi)
manifest.postInstallMessage: Open https://<your-app-domain>/dashboard — login with your Cloudron account (OIDC) or use default password: 123456. MITM proxy auto-starts on port 8443 for token optimization.
manifest.changelog:
* Restart Headroom automatically if its proxy exits
* Make bundled Headroom detectable in Token Saver settings
* Use persistent Headroom home directory and increase memory limit to 2 GB
